description: L-BFGS geometry optimization (!RDYN OPTIMIZER='LBFGS', joint with !CELL MOVE=T) on Si diamond (PBE, 4x4x4 k, 25 Ry), DAV+VARIATIONAL electrons. lbfgs_atoms: SI2 displaced by 0.05 AA along x relaxes back to the ideal structure (energy must agree with a static run of the ideal structure shifted rigidly to where L-BFGS leaves it: the shift costs 0.9 ueV of egg-box energy at 25 Ry). lbfgs_cell: same displacement in a lattice stretched by 2%, atoms and cell together (P=0). lbfgs_stress: ideal Si under P[GPA]=1 plus a uniaxial STRESS[GPA]=1 along x; the printed stress must equal P*1+STRESS=diag(2,1,1) GPa
